this_is_not_a_collection_receipt: A collection receipt is issued only by run_evidence.collection_receipt, bound to the job, the contract digest and the inventory digest. This record is not one, and it does not make the job a completed deliverable. The launcher's reading stands: execution FAILED, checkpoint_collection NOT_ATTEMPTED, measurement_completeness NOT_EVALUATED, completed_deliverable false.
what_this_is: Every results/ object from the job's bucket, copied down by hand after the worker died. The launcher's own collection never ran: it requires results/result.json, and the worker was killed before it could write one. Without this copy the only surviving copy of the recovered measurement would be the S3 bucket.
why_the_worker_died: upload_results was called without the publisher's map of what it had already uploaded, so it re-put files that were already in the bucket; each create-only put conflicted; the conflict handler read the object back to compare digests; the job role granted s3:GetObject on input/* only, so the read was denied and the denial was raised. The readout itself had already finished and its payload was already uploaded by the incremental publisher.
